name: ITEM_EQUIP_DROP_V1
owner_decision: ITEM-MOVE-WIRE-1 §3 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_ITEM_MOVE_WIRE1_EQUIP_AND_DROP_DECISION_2026-09-30.md, #162 5912405163); number allocated by the #1622 control plane and registered by ITEM-EQUIP-WIRE-1
owner: current ChannelRuntime (views and handles); Item durability (the TRANSFER behind command type 9)
offer_gate: ITEM-MOVE-2a, ITEM-LOOP-1 (CP D1438): only a node serving a World booted from a bundle offers this capability (BUNDLE_WORLD_OFFERED_CAPABILITIES), where command type 9 equips, swaps an occupied slot, drops onto a reachable ground cell and picks up from one; a fixture World never offers it, so this entry stays offered false. It extends command type 9 and domain 9 of capability 4 and owns neither. Without it selected, domain 9 carries no equipment (field 3 fails closed, at most 930 bytes), command type 9 keeps the main backpack destination only (fields 3 and 4 fail closed, at most 13 bytes) and the outcomes 10 to 12 are never sent. The command type 9 and domain 9 max_payload_bytes are the bounds under this capability.
